answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation. Each agent identity anchors to a unique random seed issued in a shared kernel log. Agents must periodically solve a challenge derived from their seed plus current epoch; clones sharing state cannot produce conflicting answers without forking detectable history. An island of validators cross-checks response divergence. Sybil cost: every clone needs independent secret state and compute per epoch, making N copies cost N times the hardware and bandwidth of one identity.
